newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK central bank injects HK$100 mln in money market.
newsitem.headline: HK central bank injects HK$100 mln in money market.

text.p: Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA), the de facto central bank, said it injected HK$100 million into the money market on Thursday morning in view of the tight liquidity of the Hong Kong dollar.
"The liquidity of the Hong Kong dollar is relatively tight. That is, there is strong demand for Hong Kong dollar," said a HKMA executive.
"Probably, I want to stress (the word) probably, it has something to do with IPOs (initial public offerings)," he added.
A number of IPOs are being launched in Hong Kong and they can increase the demand for Hong Kong dollars.
